summary: Louisiana has official Secretary of State 2024 parish presidential totals derived from precinct CSV rows, official precinct and vote-mode President-versus-U.S.-House review rows, EAC 2024 V2 jurisdiction turnout fallback rows, Census parish geometry, and county/parish equipment context. State-native turnout, precinct boundary geometry, 2012/2016/2020 historical baseline rows, and normalized audit/CVR/incident/correction/recount/litigation records remain uncollected.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State official 2024 general election precinct CSV results
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: louisianaSosPrecinctCsvDirectory via etl/state-configs/la.json certifiedResults and reviewCharts
caveats: President rows are aggregated to parish result rows for the map while local review rows retain parish, ward, precinct, and vote-mode keys where available.
U.S. House is district-based and candidate-specific, so Louisiana review charts are advisory source-review context rather than a statewide same-office comparison.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Louisiana Secretary of State 2024 general election human-readable workbook
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: louisianaSosHumanReadableWorkbook retained in etl/state-configs/la.json sources for provenance/manual inspection
caveats: The active native ETL reads the paired official precinct CSV artifacts directly; the workbook is retained for provenance and manual reconciliation.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Louisiana jurisdiction turnout fallback
caveats: Prefer a Louisiana-native turnout and registration denominator artifact if one is collected and reconciled.
EAC jurisdiction rows are official fallback denominator rows, not a substitute for precinct vote-history or ballot-cast records.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. Census TIGERweb Louisiana parish geography
caveats: Parish geometry supports parish map joins only; precinct boundary geometry is not loaded.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Verified Voting Verifier Louisiana 2024 equipment context
caveats: Equipment context is not a vote, turnout, audit, CVR, incident, correction, recount, or litigation source and does not prove every precinct in a parish used one identical configuration.

stateNativeTurnout.requestNeed: Official Louisiana ballots-cast and registered-voter denominator rows with denominator timing and parish or precinct grain before replacing EAC fallback turnout.

precinctBoundaryGeometry.requestNeed: Official statewide precinct boundary geometry or a precinct-to-parish crosswalk if subparish map overlays are required.

historicalBaselines.requestNeed: Official Louisiana presidential result artifacts for 2012, 2016, and 2020 with parish totals, source URLs, parser path, and statewide reconciliation totals before enabling historical baseline rows.

postElectionAudit.requestNeed: Official 2024 Louisiana post-election audit selection and outcome artifacts, if published or obtainable, with parish/reporting-unit grain and discrepancy fields.

cvrAvailability.requestNeed: Official SOS or parish CVR availability records, public-records request responses, or documented nonavailability notes before claiming CVR coverage.

incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.requestNeed: Official incident, correction, recount, election-contest, or litigation records for the 2024 general election, normalized only after authoritative source collection.

displayApiCaveats.advisoryUse: Louisiana advisory indicators use official precinct and vote-mode President-versus-U.S.-House review rows. U.S. House is district-based, and the review rows are screening/context signals only, not claims of fraud or misconduct.
displayApiCaveats.productionPromotion: Not authorized from worker branch; no native:promote or native:counts run.

gaps.remainingRisk: EAC fallback turnout is official but not Louisiana-native and may not match Secretary of State denominator semantics.
Public map joins remain parish geometry only.
Historical context remains disabled until official artifacts are collected and normalized.
No normalized audit selection/outcome rows are available.
No CVR availability table or CVR dataset is available.
